title: WAV Interview Cleanup and Chapters
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

A stereo 16-bit recording and transcript were added. Accept either mono or stereo. A frame is silent only when every channel is below the threshold. In this stage, --output names a parent directory: place all outputs for the requested WAV in <output>/<WAV-stem>/, for both mono and stereo, with chapter files below that directory. The command still processes the single WAV/transcript pair passed as arguments. Separate invocations with --output output must keep different WAV stems separate.
